g.text: Drawing MFG-DRV-01 | Part DRV-01 — Universal donor motor plate | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 6 mm SS400 steel | Process/finish: laser cut + standard metal angles
Overall: X 180.000 × Y 140.000 × Z 6.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: 180 x140 x6; frame holes 4xØ6.6; slots nominal per DXF; flatness <=0.5; motor-specific adapter carries motor load
GD&T/datums: A=frame mounting plane; B=primary edge; C=mounting-hole centreline; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; fit-up, PE bond where metal, reach/access and
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Release: PASS — physical validation NOT_RUN; procurement and machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
